question: What is the medical term for inflammation of the external female genitalia?
explanation: Vulvitis specifically refers to the inflammation and irritation localized to the external female genitalia known as the vulva. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h1)

question: Why is the vulva easily prone to irritation and inflammation?

options.A: It stays warm and moist, which easily traps heat and moisture
options.B: It lacks any natural skin protection
options.C: It is constantly washed by internal body fluids
options.D: It only has sweat glands that produce thick oils

explanation: The natural structure of the area creates a warm, moist environment that easily traps heat and moisture, which promotes skin irritation. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h1)

question: Which of these is a common non-infectious cause of vulval inflammation?
explanation: Chemicals in soaps and trapped sweat from tight synthetic clothing frequently trigger skin allergies or contact dermatitis on the vulva. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h2)

question: How does menopause contribute to vulvitis in older women?

options.A: Lower estrogen levels cause thinning and dryness of the vulvar skin
options.B: Weak pelvic muscles trap bacteria outside
options.C: Extra progesterone creates too much oil
options.D: Higher body temperature changes sweat production

explanation: Low estrogen during and after menopause reduces tissue moisture, making the vulva more fragile and easily inflamed. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h2)

question: Which symptom is most common and reported by almost every patient with vulvitis?
explanation: Pruritus, or itching, is the main complaint of vulvitis and usually brings the patient to the clinic. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h3)

question: What is a major risk when a patient constantly scratches itchy vulvar skin?

options.A: Permanent changes in the size of the labia
options.C: Developing a secondary bacterial infection through skin breaks
options.D: Fungal spores spreading all over the body

explanation: Scratching creates tiny cuts on the delicate skin, making it easy for bacteria to enter and cause a secondary infection. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h3)

question: What simple lab test mixes vaginal discharge with saline to check for yeast or abnormal cells under a microscope?
explanation: A wet mount preparation examined under a microscope allows quick viewing of fungal cells, parasites, or abnormal findings. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h4)

question: When would a doctor most likely recommend a vulvar skin biopsy?

options.A: Instead of doing a normal physical exam
options.B: Whenever a mild yeast infection is found
options.C: When sores or inflammation do not heal with standard treatment
options.D: During the first routine pregnancy check-up

explanation: A skin biopsy helps rule out long-term skin conditions or other serious problems when standard treatment fails to work. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h4)

question: What is a simple nursing care action to soothe inflamed vulvar tissue?
explanation: Sitting in plain warm water helps clean the area, reduces discomfort, and soothes irritated skin. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h5)

question: Why should nurses warn patients against using random medicated creams bought over the counter for vulvitis?

options.A: They quickly cause whole-body poisoning in hours
options.C: They cancel out the effect of any oral drugs
options.D: Many commercial products contain ingredients that worsen skin allergies

explanation: Fragrances and preservatives in unprescribed ointments often trigger allergic reactions and make the inflammation worse. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h5)

question: What type of underwear fabric is best to prevent trapped moisture and vulvitis?
explanation: Cotton is a breathable fabric that allows air to circulate and absorbs moisture, keeping the area dry and cool. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h6)

question: Which personal hygiene habit should nurses actively tell patients to avoid?

options.B: Washing the outside area with plain warm water
options.C: Drying the perineal area well with a clean towel
options.D: Wiping from front to back after using the toilet

explanation: Douching washes away helpful bacteria, upsets the normal acid balance, and introduces irritating chemicals into the vagina. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T6#GNS216_U5_T6_h6)
